query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Company'[Name], "IsGrandTotal"),
    "Requests", [Requests completed till now],
    "Credits", [Total credits consumed],
    "Tokens", [TokensUsed],
    "LLM Cost", [Total LLM Cost],
    "Avg Credits", [Avg credits per request]
)
ORDER BY [IsGrandTotal], 'Company'[Name]
